name: 东方故事IIv1.3b
english_description: An early build (1994-2000) of the ES II engine created by Taiwanese developer Annihilator, in Traditional Chinese, whose login banner also styles itself "Celestial Empire." Its only map content is a single snow village — plaza, inn, blacksmith, market, ruins — closer to the engine's own bundled demo village than a fully realized sect-and-jianghu game, making it the likely origin point for the "original from Lil, rewritten by Annihilator" lineage seen in later archives in this project.
